AC-1.title: Access Control Policy and Procedures
AC-1.obelisk_implementation: Automated policy enforcement via PDDL governance domains. Access policies defined declaratively, version-controlled, and enforced at runtime.

AC-2.title: Account Management
AC-2.obelisk_implementation: Automated account lifecycle management. Accounts provisioned via SCIM, deactivated automatically on termination signal. Quarterly access reviews with manager attestation.

AC-3.title: Access Enforcement
AC-3.obelisk_implementation: Mandatory Access Control (MAC) via PDDL clearance-isolation domain. Bell-LaPadula model enforced for defense deployments.

AC-17.title: Remote Access
AC-17.obelisk_implementation: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) with device posture check. mTLS required, session limited to 8 hours, continuous authentication via behavioral biometrics.

SC-7.title: Boundary Protection
SC-7.obelisk_implementation: Defense in depth with WAF, DDoS protection, network segmentation, and micro-segmentation via service mesh.

SC-8.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
SC-8.obelisk_implementation: TLS 1.3 with perfect forward secrecy. mTLS for service mesh. AES-256-GCM for application-layer encryption.

SC-13.title: Cryptographic Protection
SC-13.obelisk_implementation: FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSM for all key operations. Approved algorithms: AES-256-GCM, RSA-4096, ECDSA P-384, SHA-384.

SC-28.title: Protection of Information at Rest
SC-28.obelisk_implementation: All data encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. Keys managed in HSM with automatic rotation every 90 days.

continuous_monitoring.vulnerability_scanning: Monthly authenticated scans, quarterly unauthenticated scans
continuous_monitoring.status_reporting: Monthly to AO, annual authorization package update
